Hi Neha,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We're starting our SOC 2 readiness review for the project that will integrate Redwood in production and I wanted to kick off a short sync to understand how we get evidence out of your environment. A few quick questions up front so we come prepared: 

- Do you have the latest SOC 2 report (Type II) and control narratives we can review?
- For request/response logs and audit trails: what are the default retention windows for hosted customers, and can we request ad-hoc exports of specific time windows?
- How do you provide access to evidence (portal link, SFTP, or secure share)? Are there temporary SSO accounts we can use?
- For log samples, do you provide PII-masked extracts by default or do those need to be redacted on request?

Would you be available for a 30-min call tomorrow (Thu) afternoon? We're available 14:00-16:00 PT. If you prefer sending a brief note with the access model and attachments, that works too.

Thanks —
Jordan
Security Operations, Acme Data Systems

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmedata.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <pshah@acmedata.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 15:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Evidence access & retention questions — SOC 2 prep

Hi Jordan —

Great to hear from you. Happy to run a short call to walk through access patterns and share a baseline evidence package. Quick answers inline and a few proposed slots: 

- SOC 2 report: we maintain a current Type II report and an accompanying control narrative. I attached the standard PDF and a brief README that explains what is and isn't included in the public package. (redwood-soc2-report-2026.pdf; evidence-access-instructions.docx)

- Retention windows: hosted customers default to 90 days for high-fidelity request/response logs, 1 year for aggregated telemetry, and 3 years for compliance snapshots. We can provision extended retention for Dedicated customers or by contract.

- Access model: we support temporary SSO-based portal access (SAML/OIDC), and a secure SFTP endpoint for bulk exports. For SOC 2 reviews, we usually grant temporary, scoped SSO with view/download rights and a one-time SFTP drop for larger log bundles. Instructions are attached.

- PII/masking: we can provide anonymized/masked extracts by default for log samples. If you need original fields (for auditor inspection) we require an approved data-access request and SOC-level NDAs; that flow is documented in the attached instructions.

Proposed 30-min slots (PT): Thu 15:30-16:00 or Thu 16:30-17:00. If those don't work I can send over my calendar link.

Action items for the call (we'll run through these):
- Walk access options + temporary SSO setup
- Confirm the exact time window you need for log export
- Agree on masking vs. original fields and any NDAs required
- Set owners and target delivery dates for artifacts

If you want to go ahead without a call I can open a scoped portal account and drop a sample log bundle to SFTP — let me know the preferred window.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0124
